_note: REQ-KERN-1: the kernel is pinned by release tag AND by digest of the WASM
binary. The digest is recorded in every forecast record (REQ-DET-1), so a
kernel upgrade is visible in the provenance of every number it produced.
heapBytes and canGrowMemory describe the SHIPPED build, not a wish. This
binary is compiled without ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH: emscripten's
abortOnCannotGrowMemory calls abort('OOM'), which kills the module. See
ADR 9 — REQ-APP-7 is written for a growable build and this one is not.
